verses.text: "Even today my complaint is bitter. God's hand is heavy on me, even though I groan.
If only I knew where to find him! If only I could go to where he sits!
I would lay out my case in front of him and fill my mouth with arguments.
I would find out how he would answer me, and understand what he would say to me.
Would he use his great power to argue against me? No, he would listen to me.
There an honest person could reason with him, and my judge would set me free forever.
But if I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I cannot find him.
When he is at work in the north, I do not see him. When he turns to the south, I cannot catch sight of him.
But he knows the way I take. When he has tested me, I will come out as pure as gold.
My feet have closely followed his steps. I have kept to his way and not turned aside.
I have not turned away from the commands of his lips. I have treasured his words more than my daily food.
But he alone is God, and who can stand against him? He does whatever he wants.
He will do to me what he has planned, and he has many more plans like it.
That is why I am terrified in front of him. When I think about it, I am afraid of him.
God has made my heart weak. The Almighty has terrified me.
Yet I have not been silenced by the darkness, by the thick darkness that covers my face.
